name.ja: ピカちんキット08 エア臭ター

description.ja: • 香りでシーンを演出したいキミへ！
description.en: • For you who want to create a scene with scent!

description.ja: • 好きな匂いをブレンドして発射できる魔法の扇風機！
description.en: • A magical electric fan that can blend and emit your favorite scent!

description.ja: • テレビ番組「ポチっと発明 ピカちんキット」に登場するエア臭ターが商品化！
description.en: • The air odor that appears on the TV program "Pochitto Invention Pikachin Kit" has been commercialized!

description.ja: • どんな香りも自在にふりまけ！！手元の引き金を引いて複数の香りを発射し、遠くへ香りを飛ばせる発明品！
description.en: • Sprinkle any scent freely! ! An invention that allows you to fire multiple scents by pulling the trigger at hand, and send the scents far away!

description.ja: • ピカちん大百科に綴じられるピカちんシートも付いてくるぞ！
description.en: • It also comes with a Pikachin sheet that can be bound into the Pikachin Encyclopedia!
